ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (FlashOfSteel.cs:25-28) == cost 0 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(5m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(1)` (FlashOfSteel.cs:19-23) == both numbers, both declared.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (FlashOfSteel.cs:39-41) == `DamageCmd.deal(..., dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`, then `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` (42) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`. The draw is unconditional on both sides -- it happens even if the attack killed the target. Presentation, folded in: the NThinSliceVfx node (33) and the FastMode-dependent attack-anim delay (34-38), which is a PLAYER SETTING affecting animation timing only and touches no state.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` (FlashOfSteel.cs:47) == `self._damage += 3` (5 -> 8). The CARDS var stays 1 when upgraded on both sides.
